live_matches.event_name: New Zealand Women's Tour of England 2026
live_matches.description: England Women head into the 3rd ODI with a 1–0 lead after winning the opener, while the second match was abandoned, leaving New Zealand in a must-win situation to avoid a series defeat. England will look to seal the series at home, while New Zealand must deliver a complete performance under pressure to force a share of the spoils. Tune in to catch all the action from the 3rd ODI of New Zealand Women's Tour of England 2026, LIVE only on Sony LIV.
